title: Network Courtesy Day Count for Rental Vehicle Coordination Rentals
content:
**Day count.** Days lost to a delay the network caused on an insurance claim repair are authorized on a Rental Vehicle Coordination rental as network delay courtesy days, paid by the network, where the class has network courtesy for its own delay (marked yes for every class in the insurer coverage terms schedule). When the network's own sensor calibration on the repair order held the repair, the courtesy days are the calendar days from the calibration order's opening date to its completion date, less 1 allowance day for the calibration itself, never below zero. Where the class does not have network courtesy for its own delay, no courtesy days are authorized.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Opening date and completion date of the calibration order | The calibration order under ADAS Sensor Calibrations opened for the insurance claim repair order the rental is for |
| Network courtesy for the class's own delay | The insurer coverage terms schedule, for the class rented |

The calendar days from the opening date to the completion date are the difference between the two dates, every day counting.

## Worked figures (hypothetical dates)

| Calibration order opened | Completed | Calendar days between | Less 1 allowance day | Courtesy days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| The 3rd | The 9th | 6 | 5 | 5 |
| The 3rd | The 4th | 1 | 0 | 0 |
| The 3rd | The 3rd | 0 | Below zero | 0 |

A calibration order opened on a Thursday and completed the following Tuesday spans 5 calendar days, weekend days included, so the courtesy days are 4.
